Food Quality: The seafood tasted stale and lacked freshness. For a place that claims to specialize in coastal cuisine, this was a huge letdown.

Ambience: The interiors felt cramped and poorly maintained. Definitely not the cozy, elegant vibe they advertise.

featured_reviews.review_text:
The food was undoubtedly excellent and one of the best aspects of the dining experience. Every dish was flavorful, well-prepared, and worth the wait—if only the service had matched the quality of the food.

Unfortunately, the service was one of the worst I have experienced. Every time we asked about the status of our order, we were repeatedly told that the food would be ready in "5 minutes." This response was given multiple times, which turned out to be completely misleading. After waiting for over 20 minutes with no food served, we finally asked for the bill and decided to leave. Ironically, only then did the staff suddenly seem ready to bring out the food.

The lack of transparency, poor communication, and disregard for customers' time was extremely frustrating. It felt as though we were being given false updates rather than honest information about the delay. If there were an option to rate the service below 1 star, I would gladly give it a 0.

It's disappointing because the food itself was great, but the overall experience was ruined by the unprofessional and disorganized service. Management should seriously address these issues, as good food alone cannot make up for such an unpleasant customer experience.

Once again, I’m truly sorry for the experience. We hope to welcome you back soon and make it right.

Best regards,
Kokum

featured_reviews.name: Yogita Uchil
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are my friend, you already know what makes me happiest, fresh seafood, no fuss and flavours that speak for themselves.
When I was in Vasai, @shreyasaranoly took me to this hidden treasure of a place called Kinara. I’m told people from different parts of Mumbai willingly drive 40–50 kilometres just to eat here, and after this meal, I completely understand why.
What arrived on the table was pure joy,  the freshest Bombil (Bombay duck) coated in a light rava crust and fried to perfect crispness, tiny silver anchovies that tasted straight out of the sea, and rich, indulgent egg roe that only true seafood lovers will appreciate. No heavy masalas, no unnecessary plating.
These are the moments that make me happiest. Small things, big happiness. It had been far too long since I tasted seafood this fresh and this meal felt like reconnecting with a part of myself. Every bite was comforting, satisfying, and deeply nostalgic in its own way.
This one is absolutely worth the drive.
Mumbai folks, make that trip. Some pleasures are meant to be chased.

I visited this restaurant to celebrate my birthday, and unfortunately, it turned into one of the worst dining experiences I’ve ever had.

Food

Ambience

The service completely ruined my special day.

Food can be average and still acceptable — but service is what makes a restaurant good, and sadly this restaurant failed completely in that aspect.

featured_reviews.name: Preetham Dsilva
featured_reviews.review_text:
Been going to this place ever since it opened. Have watched it grow from a simple homely place to a popular trendy eating joint that has made Vasai eating joints a talk of the town... literally, in Mumbai people have heard of Farm House.

On the positive side, the menu keeps getting upgraded and there are often offers available on the drinks especially with Happy Hours! There is a variety of cuisines to try too. We have also celebrated our major landmark events in their banquet hall!! On the negative side, due to its popularity, a lot of school reunions and friends get togethers end up making this a little noisy!!

Overall though...good food, nice atmosphere, polite waiters all add up to a great Farmhouse experience that you want to keep coming back for.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Preetham,
It's wonderful to hear how long you've been part of the Farm House story! Watching our transformation alongside our loyal guests means the world. Your mention of the evolving menu and happy hour deals is music to our ears. We want everyone to enjoy a memorable experience here. 

Regards, 
Team Farmhouse

featured_reviews.name: Raviraj Samant
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an enjoyable stay here. There are some positive and negative points about this property which I will list below.

Pros:

The rooms are clean and the bedding is great. Had an undisturbed overnight sleep. Sheets and pillows were clean. Flooring and storage facilities were also clean.

The A/C was new and working perfectly. No complaints. The remote was functional too.

The space is ample for two. And lights are bright enough.

Food is excellent! The pizza was absolutely smashing! The thukpa soup and veg fried rice was also good. Chicken crispy tasted excellent but was initially served without schezwan chutney which they promptly delivered in sometime.

Cons:

Only 1 bottle was provided for free where else 2 bottles is the norm. Also only 1 towel was provided but we did not use it anyway because of the reason below.

The bathroom was clean but the bucket and mug were old. The mug had broken handle and was unusable. Could not figure out how to get hot water but did not bother asking about it.

The toilet pot is clean but has hard water stains which look ugly. Need thorough cleaning. The bathroom also needs a ventilation exhaust fan.

The bathroom door lock was not functioning, had to use the secondary lock.

The TV was working but the remote control for TV as well as the dish had old leaky batteries. Only few buttons were working. We had to exchange batteries between the two to operate one or the other.

The food is excellent but is priced a bit higher than expectations. Even if we leave food price aside since the quality is good, the cold drink and water is almost priced double of MRP, like an alcoholic.

And GST is charged on top of that inflated cold drink and water pricing which I feel is wrong. It’s like one charge on top of another.

Lastly, check in process took some time and was slow. Don’t know why they need 2 phone numbers when the norm is just for the one who booked. Process can be made quicker.

Overall I enjoyed the stay but it could have been better. I am happy with it but if they improve on the above things, I will definitely come back and recommend.

It’s a value for money stay.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Raviraj,
Thank you for sharing your detailed insights. It's wonderful to hear that you found the room clean and comfortable, and that you enjoyed our delicious food offerings, especially the pizza! 

Regards, 
Team Farmhouse
